instruction: I want to disable the automatic marking of emails as read when I open them. Can you configure Thunderbird to keep messages marked as unread until I explicitly mark them?

metadata.explanation: Task requires disabling automatic mark-as-read behavior in Thunderbird. The evaluator checks if mailnews.mark_message_read.auto preference is set to false. This is a standard Thunderbird preference similar to the original theme setting task.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly targets the exact Thunderbird preference (mailnews.mark_message_read.auto) that controls automatic marking of emails as read
Getter logic is correct: retrieves prefs.js file from standard Thunderbird profile location
Metric logic is correct: check_thunderbird_prefs parses prefs.js using regex, extracts key-value pairs, and compares mailnews.mark_message_read.auto against expected value (false) using eq method
Complete instruction coverage: single requirement (disable auto-read) is fully verified by checking the preference
Expected value is semantically correct: false is the correct value to disable automatic marking
Postconfig is appropriate: closes Thunderbird to ensure preferences are flushed to disk before reading
Data flow is correct: VM file getter -> Thunderbird prefs parser -> boolean comparison with expected false

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_thunderbird_prefs first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
